mapper.update: UPDATE idempotent_record SET status = 1, result_snapshot = #{snapshot}, error_msg = NULL WHERE idempotent_key = #{key} AND status = 0
UPDATE idempotent_record SET status = 0, error_msg = NULL WHERE idempotent_key = #{key} AND status = 2 AND (expire_time IS NULL OR expire_time > NOW(3))
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM idempotent_record WHERE expire_time IS NOT NULL AND expire_time < NOW(3) LIMIT #{limit}
